articles.headline: What advanced stats say about every USMNT World Cup game since 1990
articles.description: The U.S. men's latest World Cup exit was the latest in a long string of disappointments ... or was it? Let's look at the numbers behind all their tournament appearances since 1990 to get the real story.

articles.headline: Can U.S. Soccer afford to wait for USMNT coach Pochettino?
articles.description: Is Mauricio Pochettino still coach of the United States men's national team? That's the lingering question for U.S. Soccer that needs answering soon.

articles.headline: IFAB: VAR process of red card for Switzerland's Embolo was wrong
articles.description: IFAB clarified its guidance to referees which confirmed Switzerland forward Breel Embolo should not have been sent off in the World Cup quarterfinals against Argentina.
